releaseNotes: feat: Implement ShareUploadViewModel for handling file sharing and uploads
changelog: Added ShareUploadViewModel to manage the state and logic for file sharing.
Introduced ShareStep, ConflictPolicy, and ShareFileStatus sealed classes for better state management.
Implemented methods for selecting servers, navigating directories, and handling file uploads.
Added functionality for resolving server details and managing folder actions.
Created unit tests for ShareIntentParser and utility functions related to file sharing.
